title: Local-First Online: Draft and Submit a count task successfully
description: Verifies that counting a task online uses the optimistic Dexie store, saves locally, submits via the queue, and seamlessly processes the queue in the background.

steps.description: Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Select a warehouse from the warehouse selector dropdown if required
Open a pending count task to view details
Enter a valid number into the counted balance field
Verify the task is saved successfully and a success toast is shown
Select the counted task using its checkbox
Click the Submit All button to send the count to the supervisor
Confirm the submission dialog by clicking Yes
Verify the tasks are processed and submitted without errors
